description: A new-vehicle window sticker (Monroney label): the vehicle's identity, its manufacturer's suggested retail price build-up, the EPA fuel economy label, the NHTSA safety ratings and the parts content statement.

vehicle.description: The vehicle the sticker describes, from the header block.

make.description: Manufacturer brand, from the logo or company name, e.g. Kia.

model_and_trim.description: Model name and trim as printed in the title line, without the model year.

model_option_code.description: Model / option code as printed, retaining its formatting.

vin.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number, exactly as printed.

port_of_entry.description: Port of entry for an imported vehicle.

sold_to.description: The Sold To block: the party the vehicle was invoiced to.

code.description: Dealer or account code printed after 'Sold To:'.

address.description: Full address, lines joined with commas.

ship_to.description: The Ship To block: where the vehicle was delivered.

address.description: Full address, lines joined with commas.

pricing.description: The price column: base MSRP, options, destination charge and total.

base_msrp.description: Manufacturer's suggested retail price of the base vehicle, in US dollars, before options and freight.

options.description: Each priced or included option or package listed in the price column, including items marked Included.

price.description: Option price in US dollars; null when the price column reads Included.

included.description: True when the price column reads Included rather than an amount.

msrp_including_options.description: MSRP including options, in US dollars, before inland freight.

inland_freight_and_handling.description: Inland freight and handling (destination) charge, in US dollars.

total_msrp.description: Total manufacturer's suggested retail price, in US dollars.

fuel_economy.description: The EPA/DOT Fuel Economy and Environment label.

fuel_type.description: Vehicle fuel type from the label header, e.g. Gasoline Vehicle.

combined_mpg.description: Combined city/highway fuel economy in MPG.

gallons_per_100_miles.description: Fuel consumption in gallons per 100 miles.

annual_fuel_cost.description: Estimated annual fuel cost in US dollars.

five_year_fuel_savings.description: Fuel cost saved over 5 years compared to the average new vehicle, in US dollars. Negative if the label says 'You spend'.

fuel_economy_ghg_rating.description: Fuel Economy & Greenhouse Gas rating, 1 to 10: the number marked on the wider, left-hand slider under that heading. It is a different number from the Smog rating beside it.

smog_rating.description: Smog rating, 1 to 10: the number marked on the smaller, right-hand slider under the Smog Rating heading. It is a different number from the Fuel Economy & Greenhouse Gas rating.

co2_grams_per_mile.description: Tailpipe CO2 emissions in grams per mile.

safety_ratings.description: Government 5-Star Safety Ratings (NHTSA). Record each rating as printed, e.g. '5 stars' or 'Not Rated'.

parts_content.description: The Parts Content Information panel required by the American Automobile Labeling Act.

us_canadian_parts_content_percent.description: U.S./Canadian parts content for the car line, as a percentage.

major_foreign_parts_sources.description: Major sources of foreign parts with their percentages.

percent.description: Share of parts content, as a percentage.

final_assembly_point.description: Final assembly point for this vehicle, city and country.

engine_country_of_origin.description: Country of origin of the engine.

transmission_country_of_origin.description: Country of origin of the transmission.

total_additional_weight_lbs.description: Total additional weight of installed options, as printed beside the barcode.
